description: A BBC micro:bit V2 board with an nRF52833 chip, a 5x5 LED matrix, buttons A and B and an edge connector.
summary: The board runs the user's program in the iynk interpreter, in MicroPython. Pins, PWM, I2C, serial and timing follow the microbit-v2 board profile. It is not the nRF52833 chip.
button: Button pin: reads LOW when the button is pressed.
i2c: I2C on the edge connector: P20 is SDA and P19 is SCL.

models.1: MicroPython subset run by the interpreter with the micro:bit pin map.
models.2: Digital I/O on P0 to P16, P19 and P20, PWM on every pin.
models.3: 10-bit analog reads on P0 to P4 and P10, I2C master on P20 and P19, serial output, and buttons A (P5) and B (P11), which read LOW when pressed.

gap: undefined No electrical ratings are listed yet, so no pin-overload check exists for this board.
